newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 11.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 11.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average slid 156.78 points, or nearly 2 percent, to end at 8,031.22 as fresh worries about inflation sent investors running for cover.

* Indonesia's central bank, Bank Indonesia, late last week cut rates on its short-term certificates (SBIs) for periods of one week and above by 50 basis points while maintaining high rates for shorter-term papers.
* Thailand's potential creditors gathered for preliminary talks in Tokyo on Sunday to hammer out an aid package of up to $15 billion to help shore up the ailing tiger-economy.
A Thai finance ministry official said that he was optimistic about the outcome of Monday's meeting between Thailand, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and mostly Asian governments.
* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index closed down 2.50 points, or 0.37 percent, at 675.44 points as the central bank's move to ease tight rupiah supply failed to boost sentiment.
* On Monday, the rupiah was traded at 2,602.00/04.00 at 0150 GMT against an opening of 2,608.00/2,613.00.
* Komatsu Indonesia after announcement of a rise in first half net profit.

* Steady Safe as the transportation firm has reported that it might face difficulties in securing permits to go ahead with a proposed operation of luxury inner city trains in Jakarta and surrounding areas.
* Small-sized property firm Bumi Modern on reports that privately-owned Bakrie Capital planned to buy a 58-percent stake in the firm.
